items.q: so he was telling me that, "Look, you get this job in the tool room in one of the project houses

ctx.x: Been around a long time. From St. Louis. Played a good horn. And he had been -- got a job and he was living up in my neighborhood, so he was telling me that, "Look, you get this job in the tool room in one of the project houses, and you don't have to do nothing. All you have to do is set there, check the tools out to the super, he goes, he uses them, and he checks them back in to you." I said that's the kind of job I want, you know, so I looked and I saw -- I had one of these papers they called The Chief. He told…
